title: Moksha Sanyasa Yoga
translation: The Yoga of Liberation and Renunciation
summary: The concluding chapter summarizes the entire Gita, emphasizing the importance of performing one's duty with devotion and ultimate surrender to the Divine as the path to supreme peace and liberation.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज |
अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः || ६६ ||
verses.translation: Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions. Do not fear.
verses.transliteration:
sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja
ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
verses.meaning: Sarva-dharman - all varieties of religion; Parityajya - abandoning...
